name: Create and publish a portfolio
expected: A signed-in creator can publish a profile and see it in public discovery.

name: Edit a portfolio and retain changes
expected: Updated profile fields remain visible after reload.

name: Validate profile handles and unsafe project URLs
expected: Required fields are enforced and unsafe URLs are not published as clickable links.

name: Browse and search creator portfolios on mobile
expected: Visitors can search, filter and open portfolios on mobile.

name: Keep account data isolated between creators
expected: Anonymous writes are rejected and creators can edit only their own profile.
